name: Abyssal Shroud
description: Dodge up to three incoming hits within three seconds.

name: Acid Spit
description: Spit acid into an area, weakening victims.
notes: Weakness substitutes for source Rend armor reduction.

name: Acupuncture
description: Five needles converge on the aimed creature and steal life.

name: Angel Wings
description: Grant temporary flight; owned cleanup restores prior flight permission.
notes: Native flight permissions replace the source elytra-style angel wing movement and visuals.

name: Arcane Lock
description: Native composed example.

name: Arcane Shackle
description: A projectile tethers up to three creatures for four seconds.
notes: Native backing markers substitute for the source three-chain model.

name: Arrow Volley
description: Rain twelve arrows over the aimed area; each creature can take at most four impacts.

name: Ascension
description: Launch upward with slow falling while shocking nearby enemies.

name: Ball Lightning
description: A slow orb leaves a lingering electrical field on impact.
notes: Persistent impact field replaces source bouncing orb movement.

name: Black Hole
description: A fixed singularity pulls nearby creatures and pulses damage.
notes: Pull is toward the field center, with native particles and fixed duration.

name: Blaze Storm
description: Channel a stream of ten burning firebolts.

name: Blessing of Life
description: Heal an aimed allied creature.

name: Blight
description: Halve the victim’s incoming healing and apply poison.

name: Blizzard
description: A lingering blizzard freezes and slows creatures inside it.

name: Blood Needles
description: A fan of five needles transfers a quarter of damage to the caster.

name: Blood Slash
description: A piercing slash steals life from each struck creature.

name: Blood Step
description: Short teleport followed by invisibility and cleared pursuit.
notes: Aim-point teleport; entity-behind positioning is available through the teleport action but is not auto-selected.

name: Burning Dash
description: Dash forward, burning each contacted creature once.

name: Chain Creeper
description: An initial blast marks victims; their deaths propagate bounded nearby blasts.
notes: Native death-bound blasts replace the source thrown creeper-head swarm.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning jumps between four visible nearby creatures.

name: Charge
description: A ten-second charge grants movement and mining speed.
notes: Native status bonuses replace source school-power and attack-speed modifiers.

name: Cleanse
description: Remove harmful status effects from nearby allies.

name: Cone of Cold
description: Channel a freezing cone that slows victims.

name: Counterspell
description: Interrupt casting, dispel attached native effects, remove effects, or banish summons.

name: Devour
description: A bite pulls and drains its victim; a killing bite grants temporary maximum health.

name: Divine Smite
description: A holy melee strike adds half the held weapon’s damage.

name: Dragon Breath
description: Channel a damaging dragon cone.
notes: Native pulses replace residual pools; secondary per-victim explosions are removed to prevent density multiplying damage.

name: Earthquake
description: A ground field repeatedly damages and slows creatures.

name: Echoing Strikes
description: Three ordinary attacks within ten seconds produce an extra hit worth 50% of their damage.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: Three separately aimed piercing beams share a recast session with five seconds to aim each shot.

name: Electrocute
description: Channel an electrical cone.

name: Evasion
description: A one-charge dodge protects against the next incoming hit for five seconds.

name: Fang Strike
description: A line of eight ground eruptions strikes ahead.
notes: Particle eruptions replace fang models; authored damage avoids vanilla fang double hits.

name: Fang Swirl
description: A ring of eruptions appears at the aimed position.
notes: Uses particle eruptions instead of fang models; each creature is hit once.

name: Fang Ward
description: A ring of ground eruptions defends the caster.
notes: Uses native eruption particles instead of fang models; each creature is hit once.

name: Fire Arrow
description: An explosive burning arrow.

name: Fire Breath
description: Channel a cone of damaging flame.

name: Fireball
description: A charged fireball explodes on impact.

name: Firebolt
description: A fast burning bolt.

name: Firecracker
description: A lobbed firework bursts with damage and knockback.

name: Firefly Swarm
description: A damaging swarm follows its victim and spreads on death through two generations.
notes: Native following particles replace individual firefly bodies.

name: Flaming Barrage
description: Five separately aimed fireballs share one recast session with six seconds to aim each shot.

name: Flaming Strike
description: A weapon-scaled burning melee sweep.

name: Force Arrow
description: Native composed example.

name: Fortify
description: Up to four nearby allies gain four absorption HP for ten seconds.

name: Frost Step
description: Teleport away while a freezing decoy field remains at the departure point.
notes: Residual frost field replaces the source destructible ice clone and shatter shards.

name: Frostbite
description: Three ordinary attacks freeze targets; marked deaths shatter into nearby enemies.

name: Frostwave
description: A radial frost blast repels creatures.

name: Gluttony
description: Up to three foods consumed within ten seconds convert nutrition into native spell energy, capped at 200.
notes: Temporary actor energy is a runtime resource seam; no discovery or progression system is installed.

name: Gravity Fissure
description: A moving singularity drags creatures along its path.

name: Greater Heal
description: Restore up to twelve HP to the caster after a charge.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A bolt marks its target and bends nearby projectiles toward it.

name: Gust
description: A broad gust damages and pushes enemies away.

name: Haste
description: Up to four nearby allies gain mining and movement speed.
notes: Custom cast-speed bonus is outside the native status model.

name: Heal
description: Restore a moderate amount of health to the caster.

name: Healing Circle
description: A persistent circle heals up to four allied creatures inside it.

name: Heartstop
description: Defer damage for six seconds, then suffer half the accumulated amount.

name: Heat Surge
description: An outward burst burns and repels nearby enemies.

name: Ice Block
description: Throw a heavy block of ice that bursts on impact.
notes: Projectile delivery substitutes for the source falling physical block entity.

name: Ice Spikes
description: A ground line of eight eruptions freezes creatures.
notes: Native particles replace ice spike models; each creature is hit once.

name: Ice Tomb
description: A protective tomb heals while immobilizing the caster; the first hit breaks it.
notes: A native attached ward replaces the source mounted tomb body.

name: Icicle
description: A fast icicle freezes its victim.

name: Interposing Earth
description: Native composed example.

name: Invisibility
description: Turn invisible and clear pursuit; attacking ends the effect.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Strike the aimed point with an electrical burst.
notes: Native particles/damage avoid vanilla lightning igniting unrelated terrain.

name: Lightning Lance
description: A piercing lightning projectile.

name: Lob Creeper
description: A gravity-driven creeper bomb damages an area.

name: Magic Arrow
description: Charged piercing arrow.

name: Magic Missile
description: Homing missile steers toward the aimed creature.

name: Magma Bomb
description: A lobbed bomb leaves a damaging magma field.

name: Oakskin
description: Reduce up to six ordinary non-fire hits by 25% within ten seconds.
notes: Source fire vulnerability and bespoke bark visuals are deferred.

name: Air Bubble
description: Breathe through water or suffocation until safe air resumes, with a five-second maximum.
notes: A self-cast conditional rescue replaces a reaction targeting another creature. Only drowning/suffocation is prevented; ordinary attacks are unaffected.

name: Arctic Rift
description: A wide cold rift deals twenty-two HP and heavily slows at most six enemies.
notes: Freezing/Slowness replace enfeebling, slowed actions and exact line geometry; no physical terrain rift.

name: Bind Undead
description: Temporarily control one existing undead mob for eight seconds.
notes: Finite ownership replaces permanent obedience and spoken orders; players and native summons cannot be claimed. Existing AI follows/fights for the caster.

name: Breathe Fire
description: Breathe a short cone of fire into at most four enemies.
notes: A single native cone replaces saves and damage dice; burning is deterministic on contact.

name: Cataclysm
description: Channel four elemental surges into one fixed area for up to thirty-two direct HP per creature.
notes: Four explicit native phases replace six simultaneous damage categories, massive terrain effects and flying-creature exceptions.

name: Caustic Blast
description: Splash acid over a small three-target area.
notes: Three direct HP and brief Weakness replace acid dice and critical persistent damage; native damage is magic.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning jumps through up to six visible enemies for twelve HP each.
notes: A six-victim no-repeat chain replaces save-based chain continuation; each jump requires visibility.

name: Cinder Swarm
description: A following firefly swarm burns its captured creature for ten direct HP over five seconds and briefly blinds it.
notes: Only the firefly-inspired variant, with a breakable marker and fixed five pulses. The ant variant, insect models, saves and forced movement are omitted; nearby bystanders take no pulse damage.

name: Clairvoyance
description: See through a stationary sensor up to twenty blocks away for eight seconds; damage immediately ends the view.
notes: Client camera changes while the server body stays vulnerable. Fixed sensor facing and normal tracked chunks replace arbitrary remote locations/panning; casting and interaction are blocked while viewing.

name: Collective Transposition
description: Move three willing nearby allies into a supported formation at the aimed destination.
notes: Automatic fixed formation replaces independently chosen destinations. Every destination validates before any creature moves; players opt in through the development consent control.

name: Containment
description: Enclose the aimed enemy within a two-way movement boundary for five seconds; outside hits spend a shared sixteen-HP pool.
notes: Movement boundary and finite outside-attack durability replace an invulnerable tabletop sphere. It is traversable after breaking; inside attacks and terrain are not blocked.

name: Create Water
description: Add one water layer to an aimed cauldron.
notes: A finite Minecraft utility volume replaces a gallon pool. Full cauldrons fail; no fluid source block, item duplication or damaging water attack.

name: Creation
description: Assemble a temporary wooden cover, step or platform for twenty seconds.
notes: Finite presets replace arbitrary mundane objects. Geometry has collision and durability but produces no inventory items, containers or loot.

name: Detect Magic
description: Privately report whether native manifestations or equipped enchanted items are within sixteen blocks.
notes: Presence only, from loaded native state/equipped items. It does not inspect other mods, inventories or blocks, reveal hidden locations, or unlock discovery/progression.

name: Divine Lance
description: Strike one creature with a five-HP spiritual lance.
notes: Spirit damage uses native magic; deity sanctification and tabletop immunities are not imported.

name: Eclipse Burst
description: An eclipse blast deals twenty HP and briefly blinds and weakens up to six enemies.
notes: One cold impact replaces cold plus void rolls; undead take the cold component, with no permanent blindness or darkness terrain.

name: Electric Arc
description: Arc to the aimed creature and at most one nearby enemy, dealing four HP to each.
notes: A visible four-block jump replaces independently selected Pathfinder targets; no Reflex save or heightening.

name: Enfeeble
description: Weaken one creature’s melee attacks for six seconds.
notes: Weakness II replaces save-dependent enfeebled degrees; no damage.

name: Enlarge
description: Become physically one-and-a-half size for eight seconds, with one extra block of player reach.
notes: Actual synced body scale and explicit reach replace tabletop size categories and weapon damage bonuses; occupied growth is rejected.

name: Falling Stars
description: Channel twelve falling stars; each creature can take at most six five-HP impacts.
notes: Rain projectiles replace four independently located elemental bursts; shared hit caps prevent overlap multiplication.

name: False Vitality
description: Gain four temporary absorption HP for eight seconds.
notes: Vanilla Absorption I replaces tabletop temporary HP; recasts follow vanilla status replacement instead of adding pools.

name: Fear
description: Frighten one enemy, reducing its melee strength and movement briefly.
notes: Weakness II and Slowness replace frightened values and critical fleeing; native AI does not run a fear state.

name: Field of Life
description: A six-second life field heals living creatures and hurts undead each second.
notes: Indiscriminate living healing/undead damage is retained; no sustain action, restores HP rather than limbs.

name: Figment
description: A stationary four-second light-and-sound figment draws nearby hostile mobs toward its one-hit marker.
notes: A fixed wisp/lure replaces arbitrary images or sounds, skill checks and per-viewer disbelief. It deals no damage and can be struck to end it.

name: Fire Shield
description: An eight-second fire shield blocks three hits and burns nearby attackers, with limited freezing resistance.
notes: Automatic finite reactions replace choosing Shield Block and a physical held shield; only Minecraft freezing-tagged damage counts as cold.

name: Fireball
description: A fireball bursts for fourteen direct HP and burning against up to five enemies.
notes: Native capped hostile-only blast differs from indiscriminate tabletop area damage; no terrain destruction.

name: Fleet Step
description: Gain Speed III for five seconds.
notes: Vanilla movement speed replaces the fixed tabletop speed bonus.

name: Flicker
description: For six seconds, reduce four nonmagical hits by a quarter and attempt a short safe random teleport every two seconds.
notes: Native magical damage bypasses the finite mitigation, a broader exception than source force. Unsafe random destinations skip that pulse; no phased entity state or unseen geometry.

name: Floating Flame
description: A fixed floating flame pulses fifteen direct HP over five seconds to each lingering enemy.
notes: A stationary field replaces sustained manual movement; no tabletop action-per-round sustain.

name: Force Barrage
description: Three homing force bolts deliver up to nine HP to an aimed enemy.
notes: Fixed three-bolt version replaces one/two/three-action options; native projectiles can miss or be blocked.

name: Freezing Rain
description: An eight-second rain patch makes moving grounded creatures slide and obscures native perception across its edge.
notes: A velocity traction approximation and scoped creature rendering replace general weather, tabletop concealment and all block visibility; no terrain freezing or damage.

name: Frostbite
description: Chill an aimed creature for four HP and briefly weaken it.
notes: Weakness on hit replaces critical-save physical vulnerability; vanilla freezing replaces cold presentation.

name: Gecko Grip
description: Climb when touching a wall for eight seconds; crouch to release the grip.
notes: Client/server wall-contact velocity replaces arbitrary surface adhesion and ceiling crawling; no general flight.

name: Gentle Breeze
description: A six-second restorative field heals each living visitor six HP once after three seconds of uninterrupted sampled occupancy.
notes: A missing five-tick sample resets dwell; reentry cannot earn a second heal in the same cast. Undead are excluded; medical skill, affliction saves and temperature systems are omitted.

name: Gentle Landing
description: Gain five seconds of Slow Falling.
notes: A self buff replaces the falling-target reaction; must be cast before impact.

name: Glass Shield
description: A three-second glass ward blocks three HP once and lashes a nearby attacker for three HP.
notes: Automatic mitigation and magic retaliation replace raising/blocking a glass shield, saves, and critical shards; terrain is unchanged.

name: Gouging Claw
description: A short claw sweep wounds one enemy for six HP and a brief lingering injury.
notes: Wither substitutes for persistent bleed; no weapon equipment change or attack roll.

name: Gravity Well
description: Collapse the formation of at most four enemies toward one aimed anchor with a single inward impulse.
notes: One zero-damage native impulse replaces Reflex saves and forced grid distance; no persistent vortex or repeating damage.

name: Grease
description: A four-second patch slows and nudges up to three hostile creatures each half-second.
notes: Slowness and small caster-relative impulses approximate slippery footing. No prone state, real friction changes, object greasing or permanent blocks.

name: Grim Tendrils
description: A narrow void line damages four creatures at most, leaving brief lingering injuries.
notes: Wither replaces persistent bleed; eligible undead are excluded from void damage.

name: Harm
description: A ranged void pulse heals undead for eight HP or harms one living creature for eight HP.
notes: One ranged form only; eligibility uses the undead tag rather than a tabletop negative-healing rule. No area/touch variants or automatic heightening.

name: Haste
description: Gain Speed II and Haste II for eight seconds.
notes: Movement and mining speed replace a restricted extra action; no extra spell casts or attack timer bypass.

name: Heal
description: A ranged vitality pulse heals one living creature for eight HP or harms undead for eight HP.
notes: One ranged form only; no action-count variants, area form, self fallback, saves or automatic heightening. Living enemies can be healed.

name: Hydraulic Push
description: A water jet deals seven HP and forcefully pushes one creature.
notes: Native velocity replaces fixed-grid push distance and critical doubling.

name: Ignition
description: Burn one aimed creature; six direct HP within three blocks, four farther away, plus a short burn.
notes: Melee reach gives a deterministic bonus; normal hits burn rather than using a critical-hit gate.

name: Illusory Creature
description: A stationary one-hit wolf-shaped decoy distracts hostile mobs for at most six seconds.
notes: Uses a silent inert vanilla wolf silhouette with no attacks; movement, belief damage and per-observer disbelief are omitted. The proxy is targetable, not a fully nonphysical image.

name: Illusory Object
description: Show a stationary, non-solid object silhouette for ten seconds.
notes: An original translucent crate-sized preset replaces unrestricted object modeling; collision and resources stay unchanged and an attack removes the fragile image.

name: Invisibility
description: Stay invisible for eight seconds; dealing committed damage ends this cast and its two-tick refresh.
notes: Uses vanilla invisibility: armor/held items remain visible. Only committed damage ends the buff; failed swings and other hostile actions are not detected. External longer invisibility is not removed.

name: Item Facade
description: Overlay an illusory pristine-condition label and held-item glimmer for ten seconds.
notes: The initial native facade is a clearly labeled cosmetic tooltip/glimmer, not a full model replacement. Actual item identity, durability, enchantments and inventory data remain authoritative.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A narrow lightning line deals fourteen HP to up to five enemies.
notes: Native line and target cap replace Reflex saves and uncapped grid line; no terrain ignition.

name: Magic Passage
description: Open a two-high, three-deep ordinary-stone passage for twelve seconds, then restore unchanged air cells.
notes: Fixed tunnel geometry replaces arbitrary Pathfinder passage dimensions. Ores/containers are excluded; exit and permissions validate first, occupants move to a checked exit before restoration.

name: Magnetic Attraction
description: Pull up to eight nearby loose metal stacks toward your hand.
notes: A concrete ingot/nugget/raw-metal whitelist replaces arbitrary metal-material rules. Existing item entities/stacks remain intact; no equipped-item theft or copying.

name: Mirror Image
description: Three copies of the caster’s live model and equipment each absorb up to five HP of an eligible direct incoming attack.
notes: Finite deterministic mitigation replaces random target redirection. Projectiles, environmental fire and explosions bypass this initial direct-melee form; images do not block area damage.

name: Mud Pit
description: A six-second mud patch strongly slows at most four hostile creatures, fading shortly after they leave.
notes: Slowness III approximates difficult terrain; existing blocks and actual friction are unchanged. A destructible marker owns the finite field.

name: Needle Darts
description: Three needles converge on one aimed creature for at most six direct HP.
notes: Iron-looking delivery replaces held-metal material selection, weaknesses, and critical bleed; no material is consumed.

name: Peaceful Bubble
description: A traversable ten-second bubble conceals creatures across its edge from native targeting and rendering.
notes: Scoped creature privacy replaces universal sound, weather, scrying and shelter rules. No damage prevention, solid wall, private-room teleport or general sleep guarantee.

name: Pet Cache
description: Shelter your existing tame companion for ten seconds, returning the same UUID and inventory afterward.
notes: Owned non-riding, non-leashed companions only. Uses an isolated private-dimension cell and persistent emergency-return journal; an unavailable private world rejects the cast.

name: Protection
description: Reduce four incoming hits by twenty percent within eight seconds.
notes: Percentage damage prevention replaces AC and saving-throw bonuses; no alignment filtering.

name: Protector Tree
description: Grow an oak tree from real temporary logs and leaves. Its sixteen-HP pool protects three consenting adjacent allies for ten seconds.
notes: Loaded supported air and room for the entire canopy are required. Recipients are captured on placement and must stay within three blocks. Each missing trunk removes a quarter of the maximum protection; damage spends the shared pool. Only surviving owned blocks retract at expiry; edits, replacements and holes are preserved. No log or leaf loot.

name: Puff of Poison
description: A close poison puff deals three HP and poisons one creature for three seconds.
notes: Native magic impact plus vanilla Poison replaces poison dice and critical persistent damage; vanilla immunities apply to the status.

name: Read Aura
description: After two seconds of examination, privately report whether the currently held object is enchanted.
notes: Main-hand item at completion is the inspection target; only vanilla enchantment presence is recognized. No full item identification, stored discovery or observer-wide result.

name: Regenerate
description: Regenerate twelve HP over eight seconds unless fire damage ends the effect.
notes: Fire permanently ends this cast; source acid suppression, regrowing anatomy and death prevention are simplified.

name: Repulsion
description: A six-second boundary rejects enemies crossing inward, while allies and outgoing movement pass.
notes: A stationary boundary replaces save-based aura movement restrictions. Creatures already inside remain; ranged attacks pass. Position changes crossing the sampled boundary are rejected at the next tick.

name: Resist Energy
description: Halve six incoming fire hits within ten seconds.
notes: This baseline selects fire; acid/cold/electricity/sonic choices are deferred. Uses Minecraft fire damage tags.

name: Revealing Light
description: Reveal up to four creatures with Glowing and strip their invisibility.
notes: Glowing/short Weakness replace concealed, dazzled and blinded degrees; does not create a true anti-stealth perimeter.

name: Rust Cloud
description: A five-second abrasive cloud deals at most ten direct HP per creature and briefly obscures four hostile occupants.
notes: Blindness approximates obscured sight. Metal-specific expansion/weakness and item rust are omitted; no durability or terrain changes.

name: Scatter Scree
description: An initial three-HP stone burst leaves a three-second slowing patch.
notes: A particle field replaces persistent solid rubble and difficult-terrain blocks; does not change terrain.

name: See the Unseen
description: Privately outline nearby invisible creatures for ten seconds.
notes: Caster-only silhouettes replace tabletop concealed checks; no invisibility removal or public glowing. Native perception boundaries still apply.

name: Shape Stone
description: Capture one ordinary stone cell; recast within five seconds to move it to a nearby empty destination.
notes: One permanent volume-conserving cell move replaces freeform reshaping. At most six blocks between ends; no ore, containers, drops, occupied destination or invented stone.

name: Share Life
description: Transfer half an ally’s incoming damage to yourself, up to eight actual HP total, while preserving one HP.
notes: Only actual caster health/absorption loss reduces the original pending hit. Transfer cannot recursively transfer again; same dimension, consent and distance required.

name: Shield
description: A three-second ward reduces the next incoming hit by three HP.
notes: Automatic one-hit reduction substitutes for AC, a chosen Shield Block reaction, and the tabletop recast lockout.

name: Shrink
description: Become physically half size for eight seconds, with reduced player reach.
notes: Actual body clearance replaces tabletop Tiny rules. Expiry removes only its owned modifiers and searches above an obstructed restoring body; no stealth immunity.

name: Silence
description: Suppress positional sounds and explicitly vocal native delivery within a three-block region for eight seconds.
notes: Scoped sound emission/playback and an executable utterance gate replace tabletop verbal components. Existing ambient loops and non-native spell systems are outside the gate.

name: Slashing Gust
description: A narrow gust cuts at most two creatures in its path.
notes: A narrow two-target corridor replaces independent attack rolls and one/two-free-hand selection.

name: Slow
description: Slow one creature’s movement and block work for five seconds.
notes: Slowness III and Mining Fatigue II replace action loss; casting channels are not automatically interrupted.

name: Soothe
description: Heal seven HP and remove Weakness from yourself.
notes: Self healing and removing Weakness replace touch healing and the mental-save bonus.

name: Spirit Blast
description: A spiritual detonation strikes up to five enemies for sixteen HP.
notes: Native magic can strike ordinary living bodies; spirit-only interactions and possession-specific effects are deferred.

name: Spiritual Armament
description: A spirit weapon follows one target for ten one-and-a-half-HP strikes.
notes: A target-following field replaces attack rolls, a shaped weapon, and manual sustained attacks.

name: Spout
description: An aimed water spout damages and lifts up to three creatures.
notes: Always uses the small splash variant; water-surface size changes and critical effects are simplified.

name: Status
description: Privately monitor three consenting nearby allies’ coarse health, affliction count, distance and direction for fifteen seconds.
notes: Recipients captured at cast time; same-world loaded bodies only. No through-boundary public glowing, exact private health display or universal creature tracking.

name: Summon Animal
description: Summon one sixteen-HP allied wolf for twenty seconds; recasting dismisses it.
notes: A single curated vanilla wolf uses native ownership/follow/combat AI; no tabletop animal roster, source creature stats or automatic rank heightening.

name: Summon Elemental
description: Choose earth cover, air projectile drag, water firefighting or a fire-pressure body with twelve shared damage HP.
notes: Four original, stationary elemental roles replace full summoned creature stat blocks. Every mode shares native costs and lifetime/budget constraints; no bestiary or automatic source-rank scaling.

name: Summon Fey
description: A fragile fey support silhouette spends four tricks briefly slowing nearby enemies.
notes: A stationary four-use support role replaces bestiary selection, spell lists and independent initiative. No copied creature model or vex melee reskin.

name: Summon Plant or Fungus
description: Summon a stationary healing plant with six shared healing HP, or a fungus with eight shared guard HP.
notes: Two original support presets replace a bestiary. No melee minion AI; actual healed HP spends the plant budget, and destruction/expiry ends support.

name: Tangle Vine
description: A breakable vine marker tethers and slows one enemy for three seconds.
notes: A six-HP backing marker replaces escape checks and critical immobilization; no terrain vines.

name: Telekinetic Projectile
description: Hurl a six-HP telekinetic stone.
notes: A native visual stone replaces choosing a loose physical object; no inventory consumption or damage-type selection.

name: Thunderstrike
description: A thunderbolt deals nine HP and briefly weakens an aimed creature.
notes: One typed lightning impact replaces separate electricity/sonic rolls and critical clumsy/deafened conditions.

name: Time Jump
description: Briefly step out of time for one second, anchoring the body and suppressing attacks, uses and incoming damage.
notes: A bounded one-second absence replaces advancing the whole world’s time. No global time stop, movement during absence, resource regeneration or guaranteed tabletop action economy.

name: Translocate
description: Teleport to a visible dry, supported empty position within twenty blocks.
notes: Only local visible travel; loaded-space and collision validation can reject a paid cast. No distant memory destination or dimension transfer; arrival plays after success.

name: Vampiric Feast
description: A close draining touch deals eight HP and grants four temporary HP if it causes health loss.
notes: Fixed Absorption I replaces temporary HP equal to half damage; it does not heal the caster. Undead are immune to the harmful drain.

name: Vitality Lash
description: A vitality lash deals seven HP to undead and leaves living creatures unharmed.
notes: Minecraft undead membership replaces negative-healing rules; no damage to living targets.

name: Void Warp
description: Warp living flesh for five HP and a brief weakness; undead are unaffected.
notes: Undead immunity uses the Minecraft undead entity-type tag; no Fortitude save.

name: Wall of Ice
description: Raise a five-by-three wall of individually breakable ice blocks, lifting occupants as rows emerge in a frost burst. After ten seconds, surviving conjured blocks sink and shatter.
notes: A temporary one-block-thick wall replaces the former HP slab and fracture damage. Width scales with area up to nine blocks; loaded supported air cells and safe lifting headroom are required. Broken or replaced cells permanently lose ownership; expiry, dispel and unload preserve player replacements. Conjured ice yields no items or melting water.

name: Wall of Stone
description: Raise a seven-by-three solid, 40-HP stone panel for fifteen seconds.
notes: One rectangular entity collision panel replaces arbitrary permanent stone terrain; finite durability/lifetime, occupied placement rejected and no block drops. It also blocks native sight targeting.

name: Wall of Water
description: Raise a five-by-three traversable wall of real conjured water for ten seconds, extinguishing creatures and slowing physical projectiles in its cells.
notes: Water uses native water rendering and immersion physics, confined to owned cells rather than spreading source blocks. Supported loaded air is required; broken or replaced cells lose their claims. Expiry drains surviving water, preserving player replacements. No harvested water; native spell projectiles bypass the additional drag.

name: Water Breathing
description: Give up to three willing nearby allies thirty seconds of Water Breathing.
notes: Finite group environmental adaptation replaces long tabletop duration. Vanilla status merging preserves longer external Water Breathing effects.

name: Water Walk
description: Stand and move on nearby water surfaces for eight seconds; crouch to enter the water.
notes: Shared client/server contact support replaces fluid collision hooks. It does not lift submerged bodies or provide airborne flight; source/flowing-water heights are sampled.

name: Weapon Storm
description: A weapon storm sweeps up to five enemies with ten HP plus half the caster’s attack value.
notes: Uses one cone instead of a cone/burst selection; flat additive weapon context replaces dice-size multiplication.

name: Wooden Double
description: The first hit of at least eight HP sheds up to six HP and attempts a safe sideways step.
notes: Automatic finite interception replaces a chosen reaction and critical-hit trigger. Overflow remains; failed relocation never grants extra mitigation.

name: Zephyr Slip
description: The first enemy entering a two-block boundary triggers a safe three-block retreat away from it.
notes: Finite proximity entry replaces a chosen reaction; no damage immunity and an obstructed retreat keeps the effect waiting until expiry.

name: Planar Sight
description: Reveal up to sixteen nearby creatures through walls for twenty seconds.
notes: Vanilla glowing is visible to all viewers; a caster-only outline renderer remains visual polish.

name: Pocket Dimension
description: Enter a persistent private room; casting inside returns to the saved entry point.
notes: Native isolated quartz rooms replace Iron templates, furniture, and ambient presentation.

name: Poison Arrow
description: A poison arrow leaves a brief poisonous cloud.

name: Poison Spray
description: Channel a poisonous cone.

name: Poison Splash
description: Splash poison across an aimed area.

name: Portal
description: Two casts place linked, bidirectional teleport endpoints.
notes: Native particle endpoints replace portal models and oriented portal frames; duration is sixty seconds.

name: Raise Dead
description: Three owned undead fight for the caster; recast dismisses them.
notes: Vanilla zombie/skeleton bodies and AI replace Iron custom undead variants.

name: Raise Hell
description: A ground slam adds half the held weapon’s damage to a fiery eruption.
notes: One native slam; future progression does not change its present outcome.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A piercing frost ray slows and freezes creatures.

name: Ray of Siphoning
description: A single-target channeled ray heals half the actual damage dealt.

name: Recall
description: Return to a valid respawn location or world spawn.

name: Root
description: Anchor and heavily slow an aimed creature for four seconds or until its ten-HP tether breaks.
notes: Native marker tether substitutes for the source root body.

name: Sacrifice
description: Detonate an owned summon, scaling damage with its remaining health.
notes: Fixed native blast radius; source health-dependent radius is not reproduced.

name: Scapegoat
description: A goat decoy attracts nearby hostile mobs for fifteen seconds.

name: Scorch
description: A delayed ground eruption burns the aimed area.

name: Sculk Tentacles
description: Tentacle pulses damage and briefly blind creatures in an aimed area.
notes: Native particles substitute for custom tentacle bodies.

name: Shadow Slash
description: Blink behind the aimed target and slash nearby enemies with weapon scaling.

name: Shield
description: A stationary destructible ward intercepts projectiles.
notes: Native marker collision does not form the source full solid wall.

name: Shockwave
description: A wide electrical shockwave knocks enemies away.

name: Slow
description: Slow the aimed creature’s movement and digging for four seconds.
notes: Uses vanilla movement/mining penalties; custom cast-time penalties are outside the native status model.

name: Snowball
description: An explosive snowball freezes and slows an area for three seconds.

name: Sonic Boom
description: A piercing sonic beam passes through solid blocks.

name: Spectral Hammer
description: Mine a tool-aware 3×3 face of breakable blocks; honor block-break cancellation.

name: Aspect of the Spider
description: The next three ordinary attacks within ten seconds add damage when the victim is poisoned.

name: Starfall
description: Channel twenty exploding meteors; each creature can take at most ten impacts.

name: Stomp
description: A forward ground wave damages and launches enemies.

name: Summon Ender Chest
description: Open the caster’s vanilla ender chest inventory.

name: Summon Horse
description: Summon a tamed, saddled owned horse for two minutes; recast dismisses it.

name: Summon Polar Bear
description: An owned polar bear follows and fights; recast dismisses it.

name: Summon Swords
description: Three owned flying weapon carriers fight until dismissed.
notes: Vanilla vex carriers substitute for custom floating claymore, rapier, and sword entities.

name: Summon Vex
description: Two owned flying minions fight and follow; recast dismisses them.

name: Summon Zombie
description: Native composed example.

name: Sunbeam
description: A sustained piercing beam deals repeated holy damage.
notes: Native beam pulses replace the source custom beam entity.

name: Telekinesis
description: Hold the originally aimed creature for four seconds; at most three collisions inflict damage.

name: Teleport
description: Collision-checked short-range teleport.

name: Throw
description: Throw one held item with weapon damage; recover it at impact or expiry.

name: Thunderstorm
description: A ten-second storm follows the caster and strikes up to two visible nearby enemies per pulse.

name: Touch Dig
description: Break a hardness-limited aimed block using the held tool and normal drops.

name: Volt Strike
description: Dash through enemies, damaging each contacted creature once.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Two casts draw a six-second burning segment that intercepts projectiles.
notes: A two-point native segment replaces the source extendable multi-segment wall; maximum length is sixteen blocks.

name: Wisp
description: A following wisp field repeatedly damages creatures near its target.
notes: Native following field replaces the source autonomous wisp body and return animation.

name: Wither Skull
description: Slow skull projectile inflicts a withering blast.

name: Wololo
description: Change an aimed sheep to a random wool color.
